title: How to Beat Kuldra Before Everyone Else | RuneScape: Dragonwilds Boss Guide
author: Tiger with the Bars
description:
Filmed on day one of the launch, our Kuldra Boss Guide for RuneScape: Dragonwilds breaks down every step needed to defeat this challenging encounter. The fight requires you to first complete a puzzle to load up a heavy cannon before you can successfully fire it at the boss, while making sure to hide behind Commander Zilyana, the figure with the heavenly wings, to protect yourself from powerful strikes.

Watch the full strategy to master the puzzle steps, time your cannon shots, and conquer this exciting encounter.
